description.text:
Configure your Turn Touch wooden remote and put lights, music, and everyday actions at your fingertips. Choose actions for single taps, double taps, and holds, or combine several actions on one button.

Pair a remote over Bluetooth, choose your apps and devices, and customize your buttons in Settings. Turn Touch supports compatible smart-home devices and services; available functions depend on the integration and device.

A Turn Touch remote is sold separately. Some integrations require compatible hardware, local network access, or a third-party account.

Learn more: https://turntouch.com

screenshot-caption.text: Your favorite actions, one touch away

whats-new.text: Turn Touch now speaks 21 languages. Choose your language when you first open the app, or change it from Language at the top of Settings. Menus, actions, and settings are translated. Automatic follows your device language, with English as the fallback. Reopen the app after changing languages.
